name: homepage-hero-typing
title: Homepage Hero Typing
author: AlgorizeTech
description: The homepage hero with a hand-rolled typing effect and no motion library. Use it when you want the same layout without the extra dependency.
docs: Named export: HomepageHeroTypingBlock. Identical prop surface to `homepage-hero`, but the typing runs on timers instead of Motion — lighter, with less entrance animation. Uses next/link, so it needs edits outside Next.js.
